available_authorities: The convergence brief supplied for this task
Repository architecture, methodology, release, and lane documentation at the audited code head
blueprint_source.limitation: No final post-K blueprint defining K-C, L, P, Q, R, and S is tracked in the repository or included in the supplied convergence brief. Q and R are not assigned inferred product meanings.

stage_summaries.summary: Configuration-source reconciliation and a secret-safe Phase M preflight occurred, but the exact seven-cell successor cannot be frozen from the available authoritative bindings and no successor canary was acquired.
The deterministic diagnosis, attribution, evidence-qualified BadCase export, API, and Workbench platform is implemented and synthetically qualified without fabricating real BadCases.
Assuming K-C denotes final Core release closure, its keyless hard stop exists while real Matrix, paired, Judge, BadCase, exact-head CI, and tag evidence remain unavailable.

Automated code-quality enforcement is mature, while repository ownership and contribution governance are not represented by tracked ownership artifacts. Exact Phase L acceptance criteria are unavailable.

Preflight, budget, lifecycle contracts, task quality, development/held-out splits, and deterministic failure clustering are integrated. Discriminative and stress suites plus end-to-end funnel orchestration remain absent or incomplete.

One-command lifecycle, production Compose, and the bundled Workbench are integrated. Settings and run-control remain deliberately limited, and a published multi-platform distribution is not evidenced.
The isolated Custom Evaluation foundation is integrated, but custom plans cannot yet execute through the experiment runners and no custom-evaluation Workbench surface exists.

Reusable internal adapter protocols exist. A supported public Adapter SDK, discovery mechanism, compatibility contract, templates, and SDK qualification do not. Phase P implementation is outside this convergence phase.
The authoritative definition of Phase Q is unavailable, so no feature meaning or implementation claim is inferred.
The authoritative definition of Phase R is unavailable, so no feature meaning or implementation claim is inferred.
Fast and manual Full Release CI architecture is implemented and an evidence comparison surface exists. Automated regression policy and external benchmark validation are not implemented.

requirements.requirement: Preserve old Matrix, v3, v3r1, and original attempt evidence without resuming or rewriting it.
limitations: The historical timeout root cause remains UNRESOLVED.

requirements.requirement: Treat the earlier conclusion that legitimate operator configuration was absent as authoritative.
limitations: The convergence audit found the known private configuration source valid but not sourced; no value or endpoint was persisted.

requirements.requirement: Reconcile the known operator configuration source without exposing values.
limitations: Configuration validity does not explain the historical provider timeouts.

requirements.requirement: Run one exact-identity, keyless, pre-spend Phase M preflight for the intended seven-cell successor.
remaining_work: Define an authoritative seven-cell successor binding without changing provider, model, or route.
Represent heterogeneous route pricing, the Judge campaign, and per-cell resource identities in one exact preflight.
Rerun the complete successor preflight after those design blockers are resolved.
limitations: The completed preflight was configuration-focused and terminated BLOCKED; it was not an exact successor authorization.

requirements.requirement: Freeze a new 18-task, seven-cell, FORMAL n=5 successor with 630 planned subject runs.
remaining_work: Resolve the missing authoritative successor binding and preflight representation.
Freeze a new immutable plan rather than modifying or resuming v3 or v3r1.
limitations: The preferred successor identifier has no plan digest and has not been created.

requirements.requirement: Acquire at most seven subject canaries and one Judge canary, then produce an evidence-backed full-Matrix authorization decision.
remaining_work: Complete a scientifically valid successor preflight and freeze.
Obtain bounded canary evidence under explicit authorization.
Supply authoritative pricing before converting unknown cost to a monetary estimate.
limitations: Subject calls, Judge calls, and recovery attempts are all zero; cost and wall-clock projections are UNKNOWN.

requirements.requirement: Normalize compile, test, timeout, provider, protocol, tool, workspace, dependency, verifier, and artifact failures while preserving capability versus infrastructure.
limitations: Classification consumes persisted structured facts and never retroactively reinterprets historical provider evidence.

requirements.requirement: Cluster failures deterministically across cell, task, language, task family, failure class, trace, tool, and workspace-diff dimensions.
limitations: Synthetic qualification proves deterministic mechanics; substantive real clusters still depend on immutable experiment evidence.

requirements.requirement: Provide Experiment to Cell to Task family to Failure cluster to Run to Trace, diff, tool, verifier, and attribution drill-down.
limitations: The Workbench presents backend-derived analysis and does not perform browser-side failure classification.

requirements.requirement: Distinguish VERIFIED_FACT from HYPOTHESIS and prevent trace correlation from being reported as causality.
limitations: Controlled ablation strengthens association only; the contract continues to reject causal attribution.

requirements.requirement: Export evidence-backed BadCases without fabricating real cases.
limitations: No real Matrix evidence was acquired, so the three release BadCase slots remain honest placeholders. Synthetic qualification cases are never counted as real.

requirements.requirement: Integrate diagnosis into the Workbench without duplicating backend analysis logic.
limitations: The dedicated UI consumes the backend diagnosis service and remains read-only except for deterministic export generation.

requirements.requirement: Fail closed until all mandatory real release evidence is present and semantically valid.
limitations: A passing keyless Gate K proves the hard stop, not release readiness.

requirements.requirement: Bind completed real Matrix, paired comparison or no-uplift policy, controlled ablation, Judge, and three factual BadCases.
remaining_work: Complete only separately authorized, scientifically valid real campaigns.
Bind trusted artifacts and rebuild reports through the final verifier.
limitations: No successor full Matrix is authorized by this convergence phase.

requirements.requirement: Verify the final release candidate at its exact head and authorize the Core tag without merging main.
remaining_work: Run one final exact-head Full Release workflow after all mandatory evidence is checked in.
Bind its successful identity in the release manifest before any tag operation.
limitations: The audit does not assert that K-C is the official post-K name because the final blueprint source is unavailable.

requirements.requirement: Enforce tests, lint, formatting, strict typing, migrations, and whitespace integrity.
limitations: This is automated quality enforcement, not proof of ownership coverage or long-term maintainability.

requirements.requirement: Record component ownership, review responsibility, and contribution expectations.
remaining_work: Obtain the authoritative Phase L ownership requirements.
Add tracked ownership and contribution artifacts if those requirements call for them.
limitations: AGENTS.md provides task governance but does not identify code owners or maintainers.

requirements.requirement: Keep cross-lane behavior in shared, maintainable boundaries rather than duplicating orchestration and taxonomy.
remaining_work: Converge diagnosis taxonomy and future Adapter SDK boundaries without rewriting stable execution contracts.
limitations: Exact code-quality acceptance criteria for Phase L are unavailable.

requirements.requirement: Provide secret-safe readiness assessment across configuration, runtime, data, compatibility, policy, resources, comparability, trace, and budget.
limitations: The current schema cannot express every heterogeneous K-B3 successor requirement in one exact preflight.

requirements.requirement: Estimate subject and Judge calls, tokens, requests, turns, tool calls, and cost without treating unknown price as zero.
limitations: Monetary projections still require authoritative price inputs.

requirements.requirement: Expose durable lifecycle states and immutable, explicitly authorized infrastructure recovery attempts.
remaining_work: Wire Phase M lifecycle and recovery-ledger contracts into the authoritative queue and executor rather than leaving them as compatibility primitives.
limitations: The lifecycle module is validated independently; existing queue persistence continues to use legacy status transitions.

requirements.requirement: Represent digest-bound task quality and qualification without promoting imported or custom tasks into official tiers.
remaining_work: Integrate the quality record into governed task discovery and experiment planning where required by the final methodology.
limitations: The quality layer consumes evidence but does not run qualification or persist a new authoritative registry.

requirements.requirement: Freeze development and held-out membership with provenance and leakage checks.
remaining_work: Create and govern actual source-backed split manifests for suites that require development and held-out evaluation.
limitations: The repository has the freeze mechanism but no audited production split artifact.

requirements.requirement: Provide a versioned Discriminative Suite with real task definitions and qualification.
remaining_work: Define, source, qualify, version, and gate a discriminative task suite without selecting it from favorable outcomes.
limitations: The methodology labels discriminative stress as an optional future extension; it does not supply a suite.

requirements.requirement: Provide a versioned Stress Suite with explicit resource and interpretation boundaries.
remaining_work: Define and qualify stress tasks, ceilings, scheduling, and report semantics.
limitations: A future funnel-stage enum is not an implemented Stress Suite.

requirements.requirement: Aggregate evaluation failures into deterministic, inspectable clusters.
limitations: The clustering service is available to Phase M evidence consumers; the broader funnel orchestrator remains partial.

requirements.requirement: Operate the explicit Preflight, Smoke, Breadth, Informal, Formal, and optional discriminative/stress funnel with GO or STOP gates.
remaining_work: Bind stage completion evidence and explicit operator decisions to subsequent plan creation and execution.
Add missing suite definitions before enabling the final optional stage.
limitations: The canonical stage model and transition helper exist, but there is no complete funnel campaign orchestrator.

requirements.requirement: Provide keyless up, down, status, and doctor commands over a trusted product manifest.
limitations: Product lifecycle readiness does not authorize an evaluation or prove scientific readiness.

requirements.requirement: Build and serve the production API and bundled Workbench with migrations and hardened local services.
limitations: This audit does not claim that a published prebuilt image or installer has been released.

requirements.requirement: Provide usable product settings and model, provider, Harness, and capability registry experiences.
remaining_work: Define a secure operator workflow for changing supported non-secret settings and credential references if required.
Integrate Custom Evaluation navigation after its execution boundary is complete.
limitations: Settings are intentionally presence-only and registry planning remains backend-governed.

requirements.requirement: Expose safe experiment lifecycle and scoped infrastructure recovery controls.
remaining_work: Connect explicit authorized infrastructure recovery to the authoritative lifecycle service.
Keep capability outcomes terminal and prohibit retry-all behavior.
limitations: The integrated Run Control view is observational; it does not issue lifecycle mutations.

requirements.requirement: Ship a reproducible supported distribution beyond the source-checkout lifecycle.
remaining_work: Define supported platforms and produce signed or otherwise provenance-bound release artifacts if required by the unavailable final blueprint.
Qualify installation and upgrade from those artifacts.
limitations: Wheel content and source distribution behavior are tested; no published artifact or cross-platform support matrix is evidenced.

requirements.requirement: Import user-owned task packages into an immutable managed Custom namespace with provenance.
limitations: Remote transport is denied by default and must remain explicitly authorized.

requirements.requirement: Build, validate, and describe deterministic and optional Judge-rubric criteria for custom tasks.
limitations: The subsystem consumes supplied Judge evidence and does not execute a Judge.

requirements.requirement: Prevent Custom tasks and reports from becoming Official benchmark evidence.
limitations: Future execution integration must preserve the separate namespace rather than widening Official discovery.

requirements.requirement: Create deterministic Quick, Compare, and Formal custom plans and custom-only reports.
limitations: Reports summarize supplied observations; plan creation is not execution.

requirements.requirement: Execute a custom plan through approved Model and Harness runners and persist evidence without crossing into Official results.
remaining_work: Add a custom-only execution binding, persistence namespace, preflight, lifecycle, and immutable evidence loader.
Reuse approved runner implementations without allowing Custom paths into Official ExperimentSpec discovery.

requirements.requirement: Provide a usable Workbench experience for custom import, building, validation, planning, execution, and reporting.
remaining_work: Add Custom Evaluation routes and typed client views after custom execution semantics are defined.
limitations: Backend foundation endpoints are integrated, but the frontend has no Custom Evaluation route.

requirements.requirement: Reuse stable internal Model, Harness, experiment-lane, Judge-provider, and analysis backend seams.
remaining_work: Select which internal protocols are safe to stabilize publicly and separate them from private orchestration details.
limitations: Internal typing protocols are not a supported SDK contract.

requirements.requirement: Provide a versioned public Adapter SDK with documented lifecycle, capabilities, security, evidence, and compatibility contracts.
remaining_work: Define the SDK only after convergence, including package boundaries, public models, error contracts, and compatibility policy.
Add examples, templates, conformance tests, and migration guidance.

requirements.requirement: Discover third-party adapters safely and qualify them without arbitrary ambient code execution.
remaining_work: Define explicit registration, provenance, capability negotiation, sandboxing, and conformance gates.
